history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Secretariat propose solutions to Member States on the accumulation of waste in troop- and police- contributing countries’ camps.
history.administration_response: The recommendation is under implementation. The Administration will explore ways to further encourage troop- and police-contributing countries to reduce the generation of solid waste and reduce the stockpiling of various waste streams in camps during the mission sustainment phase, in particular in the context of the ongoing review of the environmental handbook for military commanders.
history.board_assessment: The Board acknowledges the stated commitment to work towards implementing the recommendation, which is considered under implementation.
